description.summary: custom optical glass material protocol for Mochi Mochi

protocol.description:
This protocol defines an explicit, declarative contract between the Mochi Mochi Wayland compositor and external client surfaces (such as desktop panels, docks, launchers, notifications, control centers, and custom client windows).
Clients bind `mochi_glass_manager_v1` and obtain a `mochi_glass_surface_v1` for any `wl_surface`. Through this interface, clients specify physical glass material properties (blur radius, optical refraction, dispersion, corner radius, opacity) and declare their relationship to the compositor's Dual-Kawase offscreen FBO backdrop sampling pipeline.
All glass property updates are double-buffered and become active atomically when the underlying `wl_surface` commits.

interface.name: mochi_glass_manager_v1

description.summary: manager for creating per-surface glass material descriptors

interface.description: Factory global interface that creates `mochi_glass_surface_v1` objects associated with existing `wl_surface` handles.

entry.name: glass_surface_already_exists
entry.summary: a glass surface is already associated with this wl_surface

request.name: get_glass_surface

description.summary: create a glass surface object for a wl_surface

request.description: Instantiate a new `mochi_glass_surface_v1` associated with the given `wl_surface`. If a glass surface already exists for the surface, a protocol error is raised.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the manager. Existing `mochi_glass_surface_v1` instances remain valid until individually destroyed.

interface.name: mochi_glass_surface_v1

description.summary: glass material and backdrop integration descriptor

interface.description:
An interface attached to a `wl_surface` controlling real-time glass rendering parameters, optical refraction, and FBO sampling inclusion.
All state set on this interface is double-buffered: property changes are staged until `wl_surface.commit` is called.

enum.name: style
enum.description: Selects a base material style or allows full manual parameterization.

entry.name: frosted_glass
entry.summary: translucent frosted glass with micro-roughness noise

entry.name: liquid_glass
entry.summary: optical Snell refraction with chromatic dispersion

enum.name: backdrop_mode

description.summary: controls surface interaction with offscreen backdrop sampling

enum.description: Determines how this surface interacts with the Dual-Kawase FBO pyramid.

entry.name: normal
entry.summary: sample underlying content and contribute normally to the scene

entry.name: exclude_from_backdrop
entry.summary: exclude this surface from being captured into lower blur passes

entry.name: xray
entry.summary: sample only the root wallpaper and lower layer shell, ignoring intermediate windows

request.name: set_style
request.description: Sets the base visual style preset for this surface.

request.name: set_blur_radius

description.summary: set the Dual-Kawase blur radius in pixels

request.description: Sets the effective blur radius in pixels (0 = no blur, 128 = maximum diffusion). Passing 0 disables the blur pass for this surface.

request.name: set_opacity
request.description: Sets the glass backdrop surface opacity in fixed-point 24.8 format (0.0 = fully clear transparent glass, 1.0 = opaque).

request.name: set_corner_radius

description.summary: set rounded corner radius in pixels

request.description: Specifies the SDF rounded corner clip radius in pixels (0 = sharp square corners).

request.name: set_refraction_strength

description.summary: set liquid glass Snell refraction strength

request.description: Sets the optical refraction strength in fixed-point 24.8 format (typically 0.00 to 0.10).

request.name: set_noise_intensity
request.description: Sets the procedural noise grain intensity in fixed-point 24.8 format (typically 0.00 to 0.08).

request.name: set_specular_intensity
request.description: Sets the light edge and specular reflection intensity in fixed-point 24.8 format (0.0 = matte, 1.0 = sharp gleam).

request.name: set_backdrop_mode
request.description: Sets the backdrop mode: normal, exclude_from_backdrop, or xray.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the glass surface object and reverts the underlying `wl_surface` to default compositor material rendering.
